name: Kettlebell Clean
description: Bringing a kettlebell from the floor/hang to the rack position — technical focus on avoiding the bell 'banging' into the forearm.

commonFaults.fault: Bell crashing into the forearm/wrist
commonFaults.cue: Rotate the hand around the bell smoothly rather than muscling it up

stages.name: KB Clean — Light Bell
stages.description: Technique focus on the no-bang catch.

name: Kettlebell Snatch
description: Taking a kettlebell from between the legs to full overhead lockout in one motion.

commonFaults.fault: Bell banging the forearm at the top
commonFaults.cue: Punch the hand through as the bell reaches the top, avoiding a hard catch

name: Turkish Get-Up
description: Multi-stage movement from lying to standing while keeping a weight locked out overhead — full-body stability and coordination.

commonFaults.fault: Rushing through the transitions
commonFaults.cue: Move slowly and deliberately through each position

name: Windmill
description: Standing hip hinge with a kettlebell locked out overhead, opposite hand reaching toward the floor.

commonFaults.fault: Bending the overhead arm during the hinge
commonFaults.cue: Keep the overhead arm locked out throughout the movement

scaling.description: No weight, focus on hip hinge and hamstring stretch

name: Dumbbell Snatch
description: Single-arm dumbbell taken from the floor to full overhead lockout in one motion.

commonFaults.fault: Muscling the dumbbell up with the arm alone
commonFaults.cue: Drive with the hips and legs, let the arm guide rather than lift

name: Dumbbell Clean
description: Bringing dumbbells from the floor to the front rack position.

commonFaults.fault: Rounding the back during the initial pull
commonFaults.cue: Hinge and brace as with a deadlift before pulling

stages.name: Full DB Clean to Front Rack

name: Dumbbell Thruster
description: Front squat linked into a press using dumbbells instead of a barbell — same pattern as the barbell Thruster.

commonFaults.fault: Pausing at the top of the squat before pressing
commonFaults.cue: Use the rebound out of the squat to drive the press

name: Devil's Press
description: A Burpee combined directly into a two-arm Dumbbell Snatch — a demanding, CrossFit Games-style movement.

commonFaults.fault: Rushing the transition from burpee to snatch
commonFaults.cue: Reset grip and breath before initiating the snatch

name: Renegade Row
description: Plank position, rowing one dumbbell at a time while stabilizing with the other arm.

commonFaults.fault: Hips rotating with each row
commonFaults.cue: Keep hips square, widen stance if needed for stability

name: Shoulder-to-Overhead (Dumbbell)
description: Pressing dumbbells from the shoulder to overhead lockout, strict or with leg drive.

commonFaults.fault: Uneven press between arms
commonFaults.cue: Press both dumbbells at the same pace and path

scaling.description: Working weight, push press or push jerk pattern

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
description: Bench press variation using dumbbells — allows a greater range of motion than a barbell.

commonFaults.fault: Dumbbells drifting together or apart
commonFaults.cue: Keep dumbbells stacked over the shoulders throughout

name: Medicine Ball Clean
description: Lifting a medicine ball from the floor to the chest/shoulder — feeder movement for Wall Ball.

commonFaults.fault: Rounding the back to scoop the ball
commonFaults.cue: Hinge and brace as with a deadlift

name: Medicine Ball Slam
description: Explosively slamming a medicine ball to the ground from overhead — power and conditioning movement.

commonFaults.fault: Only using the arms, not the hips
commonFaults.cue: Drive the slam with hip flexion, not just the arms

name: Medicine Ball Carry
description: Loaded carry using a medicine ball held at the chest — same coaching cues as Farmer Carry.

commonFaults.fault: Ball drifting away from the chest
commonFaults.cue: Hug the ball tight against the chest throughout

name: Overhead Stability
description: Umbrella entry for overhead-position stability drills supporting Strict Press, Overhead Squat, and Snatch work.

commonFaults.fault: Load drifting forward of the ear
commonFaults.cue: Stack the load directly over the shoulder/ear

drills.name: Bottoms-Up Kettlebell Hold
drills.description: KB held upside down at rack/overhead position, forces active grip and shoulder stabilization.

drills.name: Overhead Plate Hold
drills.description: Light plate held overhead with arms locked out, walking or static.

drills.name: Waiter's Carry
drills.description: Single dumbbell/KB balanced overhead, palm up, walking.

name: Shoulder Stability
description: Umbrella entry for band-based accessory work supporting all pressing and pulling movements.

commonFaults.fault: Using momentum instead of controlled tension
commonFaults.cue: Slow the tempo, keep constant tension on the band

drills.name: Band Pull-Apart
drills.description: Band held at shoulder width, pulled apart across the chest.

drills.name: Band External Rotation
drills.description: Elbow pinned at side, rotating forearm outward against band tension.

drills.name: Wall Slide
drills.description: Back against wall, sliding arms up/down maintaining contact.

name: Scapular Push-ups
description: Plank position, protracting and retracting the shoulder blades without bending the elbows — feeder for Push-up and HSPU work.

commonFaults.fault: Bending the elbows
commonFaults.cue: Keep arms locked straight, movement comes only from the shoulder blades

name: Hip Mobility
description: Umbrella entry for hip-opening drills supporting squat depth and Olympic lifting positions.

commonFaults.fault: Forcing range of motion with momentum
commonFaults.cue: Ease into each stretch gradually, avoid bouncing

drills.name: 90/90 Stretch
drills.description: Seated, both legs bent at 90 degrees in opposite rotations, shifting weight between sides.

drills.name: Couch Stretch
drills.description: Rear-foot-elevated hip flexor stretch, back knee down near a wall/couch.

drills.name: Pigeon Pose
drills.description: Front leg bent across the body, back leg extended, folding forward.

drills.name: World's Greatest Stretch
drills.description: Lunge position with a rotational reach, covers hips and thoracic spine together.

name: Thoracic Mobility
description: Umbrella entry for upper-back mobility drills supporting overhead positions and front rack.

commonFaults.fault: Rotating from the lower back instead of the upper spine
commonFaults.cue: Keep hips still, isolate the rotation to the upper back

drills.name: Foam Roll Extension
drills.description: Foam roller under mid-back, extending over it to open the upper spine.

drills.name: Open Book Stretch
drills.description: Side-lying, rotating top arm across the body to open the chest.

drills.name: Thread the Needle
drills.description: Quadruped position, threading one arm under the body to rotate the spine.

scaling.description: Deeper range, held briefly at end range

name: Ankle Mobility
description: Umbrella entry for ankle dorsiflexion drills supporting squat depth, especially for Pistol Squat and Front Squat.

commonFaults.fault: Heel lifting during the stretch
commonFaults.cue: Keep the heel planted, only drive the knee forward

drills.name: Banded Ankle Distraction Stretch
drills.description: Band anchored low, looped around the ankle, driving the knee forward over the toes.

drills.name: Wall Calf Stretch (Knee-to-Wall)
drills.description: Foot staggered back, driving the front knee toward a wall without heel lift.

drills.name: Heel-Elevated Squat Hold
drills.description: Holding a deep squat with small plates under the heels, gradually reducing elevation over time.

scaling.description: Longer holds, minimal or no elevation

name: Single-Leg Balance
description: Simple single-leg stance holds — a feeder drill for Pistol Squat.

commonFaults.fault: Gripping the floor with the toes for stability
commonFaults.cue: Relax the foot, balance through the whole foot

scaling.description: 30 sec+/side, eyes closed or on an unstable surface

name: Burpee
description: Full-body conditioning movement combining a squat, plank, push-up, and jump — a CrossFit staple and prerequisite for Burpee Box Jump (Over) and Devil's Press.

commonFaults.fault: Not achieving full hip extension at the top
commonFaults.cue: Fully stand and extend the hips before dropping back down

stages.name: Step-Back Burpee (no push-up)
stages.description: Stepping instead of jumping back, no push-up.

stages.name: Burpee with Jump/Clap
stages.description: Jump and clap overhead at the top.
